decisions.reason: It is closely aligned with the firm's move toward integrated, data-driven airport operations and now has another year of market presence supporting continuation.
As a connectivity module for apron operations, it fits well with the firm's installed base and software stack, so it remains more valuable to retain than to withdraw.
Billing software is less central than operational airside products, but it still broadens the airport software offering and is worth keeping unless focus tightens further.
Apron resource management directly supports throughput and bottleneck reduction, which matches the firm's core customer value proposition and favors keeping it on the market.
